_readme: NetLab settings. On first run this file is copied to settings.json; edit settings.json, not this file. Every limit NetLab uses comes from here or from the detected hardware - nothing is hard-coded in the scripts.

paths._readme: Empty = chosen by Setup (SSD for the WSL distro, HDD for data if you have one).

wsl._memory: WSL max memory = total RAM - max(memoryReserveMinGB, memoryReservePercent % of RAM). 8 GB -> 5 GB, 16 GB -> 12 GB, 32 GB -> 24 GB.
wsl._autoMemoryReclaim: gradual | dropCache | disabled. Gives memory WSL is not using back to Windows.

deploy._maxWorkers: How many nodes boot in parallel. 0 = one per CPU thread.
deploy._bootTimeoutS: How long to wait for every node to finish booting after a deploy.

ram._readme: Only used to WARN before starting a lab. Nothing is reserved. Update these after measuring (Lab menu -> boot time & RAM report).
ram._vmKinds: Node kinds that are full virtual machines (QEMU). NetLab warns before starting them.

tests._retries: Connectivity tests retry this many times (5 s apart) while routing converges.
